assignments.reason: Clapping hands (מחאת כפים) is the sacred physical act of the hands — the כ"ח פרקין דידים (28 joints of the hands) awakening the כ"ח אתוון דבראשית (28 letters of Creation). By essential nature, clapping is the hands-domain action that produces holy air (אוויר קדוש) and thereby creates the conditions of Eretz Yisrael. The hands/clapping cluster belongs to Package 2 because the 28 joints/letters — which additions already assigned to Package 2 — are structurally identical to the clapping act itself. Clapping IS the physical expression of the 28-unit creative power that defines the Eretz Yisrael sacred-space domain. Polarity is good: in the Torah's context, clapping purifies the air for holy prayer.

assignments.node_id: הוא דר באוירא דארץ־ישראל, ויש לו אלוקי
assignments.reason: This node describes the state of dwelling in the air of Eretz Yisrael and having God — which is the defining identity of Package 2. The text states 'כל הדר בארץ ישראל דומה כמי שיש לו אלוקי' (Ketubot 110b). By essential nature, this IS the very quality that defines Package 2's 'לפני ה אלקיכם' node: being before God = being in Eretz Yisrael = having God. This is the achieved state of the sacred-space dimension. Polarity is good: this is the holy condition of dwelling in divine presence.

This node states that prayer is situated in the air of Eretz Yisrael. Although it mentions prayer (Package 1 territory), the essential content is WHERE prayer occurs — in the sacred space of Eretz Yisrael's holy air. The node describes the spatial/environmental dimension of prayer, which is Package 2's domain: the sacred-space that receives and houses prayer. By essential nature this is about the air of Eretz Yisrael achieving its purpose, not about prayer's internal faith-covenant dimension. Polarity is good: prayer in holy air is a holy state.

The nullification of foreign/idolatrous thoughts (נתבטל מחשבות עכו"ם) is by essential nature the triumph of faith (אמונה) over its opposite. The text explicitly states 'ונגד אמונה, הם הכפירות מחשבות עכו"ם' — foreign thoughts are the COUNTER to faith. When they are nullified, faith is restored. This is the positive outcome in the prayer/faith domain: prayer can now function as faith (תפלה = אמונה). The essential nature of this node is the restoration of the faith/prayer reality — Package 1's core identity. Polarity is good: the nullification of evil thoughts is a holy achievement.

Being saved from foreign thoughts (נצול ממחשבות זרות) is essentially the same spiritual reality as נתבטל מחשבות עכו"ם — the prayer-faith dimension being freed from its counterforce. The text frames this in the context of tzedakah to Eretz Yisrael enabling one to be saved from the מבול (flood) of confusing thoughts. By essential nature, being saved from foreign thoughts means that prayer can function as undisturbed faith — this IS the achieved state of Package 1 (prayer = faith = covenant). Polarity is good: salvation from the evil thoughts is a holy state.

assignments.node_id: נתעורר ונתתקן ברית עולם, בחינות תפלה, ח"י ברכאן דצלותא, צדיק חי עלמין
assignments.reason: This compound node explicitly names the core concepts of Package 1: ברית עולם (eternal covenant), תפלה (prayer), ח"י ברכאן דצלותא (18 blessings of the Amidah), צדיק חי עלמין (the righteous one who lives in all worlds). Every term in this node IS a different expression of the same covenant-prayer-faith reality that defines Package 1. The ברית עולם being awakened and fixed is the consummation of what Package 1 represents. Polarity is good: these are all holy concepts in the domain of the covenant between Israel and God.

The secrets of the Torah (סודות התורה) are revealed through prayer — 'על ידי התפלה נתגלה סודות התורה'. By essential nature, Torah secrets are the hidden dimension of divine wisdom that can only be accessed through the prayer-faith channel. The text equates them with כבשונו של עולם (the hidden depths of the world) and כבשי דרחמנא (the Divine mysteries). In this Torah, these secrets are the spiritual fruit of the prayer-faith-covenant domain: what prayer, when functioning as faith, opens up. Their essential nature is the revelatory content of genuine prayer — making them part of Package 1's internal/spiritual domain. Polarity is good: Torah secrets are holy wisdom.

Charity for Eretz Yisrael (צדקה דארץ ישראל) is by essential nature an act directed toward and connected with the Land of Israel. The text states: 'שיתן צדקה לארץ ישראל, ועל ידי זה הוא נכלל בארץ ישראל' — through this charity one becomes included in Eretz Yisrael. The essential nature of this node is the Eretz Yisrael connection: tzedakah here is not generic charity but specifically the act of attaching oneself to the sacred-space domain. It is the practical means of entering Package 2's territory — the land 'שנאמר בה: ארץ אשר תמיד עיני ה אלקיך בה'. Polarity is good: charity directed to the Holy Land is a holy act.

assignments.node_id: שנתעורר ידיו של הקדוש־ברוך־הוא כנ"ל, על־ידי־זה נתתקן הרהורי עכו"ם
assignments.reason: This compound node describes God's hands being awakened (through human clapping), which then rectifies foreign thoughts. The essential nature is the divine-hand response — God's hands mirroring human hands (מחאת כף). The text interprets 'והיית עטרת תפארת ביד ה' — through the HAND of God (על ידי יד ה'), through clapping, God's hands are awakened. The hands/כח domain is Package 2's structural territory (the 28 joints = 28 letters = the physical/creative-power dimension of Eretz Yisrael). The divine hand is the heavenly counterpart of the earthly clapping that creates the sacred-space conditions. Polarity is good: God's hands being awakened is a holy reality that crowns Tiferet.
